name: RAA Membership
description: The complete RAA member experience from joining through to ongoing engagement, covering digital self-service, member benefits, and roadside assist.

stages.name: Join & Onboard
stages.description: The new member discovers RAA, decides to join, creates an account, and receives their membership card.
actions: Visit raa.com.au and explore membership options
thoughts: How much is membership?
What do I get as a member?
Is roadside assist worth it?

painPoints.description: The membership benefits page lists over 50 partner discounts but doesn't personalise or prioritise them. New members don't know where to start.

opportunities.description: Show a personalised 'Your top 5 benefits' based on location, age group, and products held immediately after joining

stages.name: Set Up Account
stages.description: The member logs into My Account for the first time, reviews their dashboard, and explores their products.
actions: Click Log in to My Account
View My Account dashboard for the first time
thoughts: Where do I log in?
What was my password?
What does My Account actually let me do?

painPoints.description: No social login option (Google, Apple). Members must create and remember a separate RAA password. 6 of 8 participants in the March 2026 usability test expected social login.
The login page has no indication of what My Account lets you do, reducing motivation for first-time visitors who aren't sure it's worth logging in.
62% of My Account sessions end on the dashboard without navigating deeper. Members check their summary and leave — suggesting the dashboard isn't prompting meaningful action.

opportunities.description: Add social login (Google, Apple) to reduce friction and eliminate password management
Add value proposition messaging on the login page explaining what members can do in My Account

stages.name: Manage Account
stages.description: The member manages their personal details, updates payment information, and navigates their membership profile.
thoughts: How do I change my address?
Is my payment card still valid?
What communications am I signed up for?

painPoints.description: Changing address requires updating it separately for membership AND each insurance policy — it's not synced. This generates 34 support tickets per month and is the single highest-volume complaint for My Account.
No confirmation email or notification after updating payment details. Members don't know if the change worked and sometimes submit it twice.
Communication preferences page has 8 different toggles with no clear explanation of what each controls. Most members leave all defaults on.

opportunities.description: Sync address changes across membership and all linked products in a single update
Send a confirmation email after any detail change with a summary of what was updated

stages.name: Explore Products
stages.description: The member browses available RAA products and services beyond core membership — insurance, roadside tiers, travel, and partner offers.
actions: Investigate travel insurance and partner services
thoughts: What does RAA offer beyond basic membership?
Is bundling products with my membership worthwhile?
How does RAA compare to standalone insurance providers?

painPoints.description: No product comparison tool within My Account. Members can't easily see what they already hold versus what else is available to them.
Member discount on insurance isn't prominently communicated during the product exploration phase. Many members don't know they get a discount for bundling.

opportunities.description: Show personalised product recommendations in My Account based on the member's current products and profile
Surface the member discount for bundled insurance products prominently on the insurance landing page

stages.name: Use Benefits
stages.description: The member discovers and uses their membership benefits, including roadside assist, partner discounts, RAA Rewards, and travel services.
actions: Scroll to member benefits on the dashboard
thoughts: What discounts can I get?
Is my membership paying for itself?
How do I use my card in store?

painPoints.description: The benefits section is below the fold on the dashboard. Analytics show most members don't scroll past their products, so many are unaware of the discounts they're entitled to.
Clicking RAA Rewards or competitions opens in a new tab on an external site, losing the My Account context and creating a jarring experience.

opportunities.description: Surface a personalised 'Top benefit for you' card above the product list on the dashboard, based on member location and interests

stages.name: Renew Membership
stages.description: The member faces their annual membership renewal and decides whether to continue, upgrade, or cancel their RAA membership.
actions: Receive membership renewal notice by email
Consider whether membership value justifies the cost
thoughts: Has the membership fee gone up?
Have I actually used my benefits this year?
Is this still worth it compared to standalone alternatives?

painPoints.description: The membership renewal email doesn't include a summary of benefits the member used during the year. Members can't easily see the value they've received.
No easy way to downgrade membership tier online. Members who want a lower tier must call rather than self-serve.
Annual fee increases aren't communicated in advance — members only find out when the renewal notice arrives, giving them no time to budget.

opportunities.description: Include a personalised 'Your year in review' summary in the renewal email — total savings from discounts, number of roadside calls, services used
Allow self-serve membership tier changes (upgrade or downgrade) through My Account without requiring a phone call

stages.name: Get Help
stages.description: The member needs assistance — contacting support, accessing roadside assist, or resolving a complaint.
actions: Search for help in raa.com.au or My Account
Call RAA support or roadside line
Follow up if issue isn't resolved
thoughts: Can I sort this online?
Why do I have to call — can't I just message someone?
Why do I have to prove who I am every time I call?

painPoints.description: No live chat or messaging channel. Support is phone-only during business hours. Members who discover an issue at night or on weekends have no self-service option.
Members must re-verify their identity (name, DOB, membership number) every time they call, even if they called the previous day about the same issue.
FAQ and help content is hard to find and often doesn't address specific member scenarios. Search returns generic results rather than member-context-aware answers.

opportunities.description: Add live chat support during business hours, with async messaging (like a support inbox) available outside hours
Build member-context-aware help: when a member searches for help in My Account, show answers relevant to their specific products and recent activity

insights.description: 62% of My Account sessions end on the dashboard without navigating deeper. Members check their summary and leave — meaning the value of deeper features (policy details, benefits, documents) is going unrealised for the majority of users.

The address sync issue — updating separately across membership and each linked product — generates 34 support tickets per month. This is the single highest-volume complaint category across all My Account interactions.

6 of 8 participants in the March 2026 usability test expected social login on the login page. 3 participants attempted to click where a Google button would be — a consistent expectation that's currently unmet.

Member benefits (discounts, rewards, roadside) are the highest-satisfaction touchpoint in the member experience, yet they are the least surfaced in My Account — sitting below the fold and hidden behind an external site redirect.
Members who receive a benefits-usage summary at renewal have a measurably higher renewal rate. The current renewal email contains no personalised usage data.

Support contact rate is highest in the 48 hours after a major life event (new home, new car, relocation). These are predictable moments where proactive digital self-service could deflect the majority of calls.

changelog.description: Updated parent journey: separated from Insurance hierarchy, replaced 'Get Insurance' stage with 'Explore Products', updated renewal and help stages to focus on membership experience
Parent journey map created with aggregated data across My Account and member lifecycle
